name: Salamun Qawlam Mir Rabbir Rahim
short_desc: A minimal composition inspired by stillness.This vibrant hand-painted acrylic artwork displays Salamun Qawlam Mir Rabbir Rahim (Surah Yaseen: 58) in bold white script over a stunning rainbow marble backdrop. Enhanced with shimmering gold leaf veins and sealed with a gloss varnish, this contemporary piece brings energetic elegance to any modern living space.
seo_title: Modern Abstract Rainbow Marble Islamic Art – Salamun Qawlam Mir Rabbir Rahim Acrylic Calligraphy
description:
Elevate your contemporary home interior with this dynamic, high-end Islamic calligraphy artwork designed to bring spiritual warmth and vivid artistic energy into your living space. This modern masterpiece features the beloved Quranic verse Salamun Qawlam Mir Rabbir Rahim ("Peace," a word from a Merciful Lord - Surah Yaseen: 58) rendered in striking, fluid white Arabic typography across the center of the design.

Handcrafted using premium acrylic paints, the background features a colorful, abstract marble-effect blend showcasing rich shades of crimson red, fiery orange, emerald green, deep cobalt blue, and royal purple. Elegant, liquid-style gold leaf cracking veins weave throughout the canvas, adding a luxurious metallic glow that captures ambient light beautifully.

To preserve the artwork's brilliance and ensure long-lasting durability, it is sealed with a high-gloss varnish finish. This protective coating guards the acrylic layers against dust, moisture, and color fading over time while enhancing the depth and intensity of the vivid rainbow gradient.

Enclosed in a sleek frame, this expressive abstract piece serves as a captivating focal point for contemporary living rooms, entryways, feature walls, or modern gallery displays, perfectly uniting sacred traditional calligraphy with modern abstract art.
Key Specifications & Features:

Medium & Materials: Premium heavy-body acrylic paints with gold leaf accenting

Surface Coating: Protective gloss varnish seal for enhanced vibrancy and color protection

Theme & Script: Salamun Qawlam Mir Rabbir Rahim (Surah Yaseen: 58)

Color Palette: Multi-color rainbow marble background (red, orange, green, blue, purple) with bold white calligraphy and gold leaf veins

Style: Contemporary Abstract Marble / Modern Islamic Calligraphy Fusion

Ideal Placement: Modern living room feature wall, hallway gallery, dining space, or creative office
